It's a custom frame, faster than anything we've got, and it acts twice every round - but never repeats the same strike. It also overclocks, running hot, which means it hits harder but takes harder hits too. What's more, VEX learns and remembers from prior fights, so we can't rely on any one tactic to take it down. I want all of you to keep your heads on a swivel and watch each other's backs - our priority is getting out of this alive, not just taking down VEX.
